threads.body: [Testing] Optional: use `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)` with the complete expected attributes for both client and server spans in `streamingErrorReturned`. The current assertions check only `error.type`, so unexpected attributes pass unnoticed. Follow the mode-dependent attribute assertions in the neighboring streaming test, adapting the status and message counts for this error case.

replies.body: Updated the test to assert the complete mode-dependent attributes for both spans, including status codes and zero message counts. Commit: `2b0e6eb947`.
